sourceContext: Draft reissue of TeamGest local QA command after canonical identity reconciliation
objective: Continue and certify TeamGest as a tested, migration-ready, local-first hours-first operations system within the canonical local repository.
why: Reuse the accepted historical TeamGest scope and existing implementation evidence after reconciling the project identity without repeating or duplicating work.
scope: reconcile existing TeamGest Brain and workstream identity
run deterministic local tests, lint and typecheck/build
run localhost route and hours-first browser QA with synthetic data
fix proven local defects and preserve local-first storage, migrations, backup/import and audit boundaries
write durable local evidence and checkpoints
outOfScope: secrets, credentials, payments, calendar and pipeline scope
acceptanceCriteria: canonical Brain and command identity match the registered PROJECT_ID
existing safe implementation evidence is reconciled rather than repeated
lint, typecheck, build and available deterministic tests pass
primary local routes and hours-first flows pass browser QA or are explicitly tooling-deferred
P0, P1 and blocking P2 findings are zero
no forbidden external or destructive action occurs
allowedAutonomy: write documentation and durable local evidence
create local commits or checkpoints without push
forbiddenActions: use production credentials or real data
requiredApprovals: main merge, push, deployment or remote-data actions if later requested
stopConditions: P0, P1 or blocking security finding
verificationRequirements: git identity, ancestry and diff verification
durable checkpoint and final Git status
